+# specflow release 0.1: fast path through 00009 and 00001
+
+Written 2026-11-09 at master `956eab5`. Measured with
+`validate_spec.py status --json`, the task files, the eval inventory, and the
+installed host CLIs. Amended the same day at `f298da9`: the parallel lanes of
+phase 1 and the early 00001 lane were wrong (section 7, item 6); probes now
+come before phase 0. Executed plans leave this folder when the work is done.
+
+## 1. What is left
+
+| Spec | Phase | State file | Tasks open |
+|---|---|---|---|
+| 00009 cross-host validation | requirements (receipts only) | missing | 10 of 10 |
+| 00001 initial delivery (release) | requirements (receipts only) | missing | 8 of 8 |
+
+00001 depends on 00009. Specs 00002 to 00008 and 00010 are complete.
+`check_rules.py` already passes unfiltered from the repository root, so every
+behavioral rule has an eval record; nothing has ever run on a host.
+
+## 2. Where the time goes
+
+| Measure | Value |
+|---|---|
+| Sessions written / still to write | 51 / 8 (`concurrent-edit`, `conversion-calcard`, `comparison-design`, `comparison-tasks`, `recover-native-kiro`, `resume-kiro-bugfix`, `resume-kiro-design-first`, `configured-specs-folder`) |
+| Developer turns across the 51 sessions | 219 (about 245 with the 8 new ones) |
+| Eval records / rubric assertions | 470 / 464 (design-review 102, review-specs 77, review-walkthrough 56, requirements-review 38) |
+| Rules mapped from the six retiring skills (parity rows) | 431 |
+| Supported hosts | 3 (Kiro IDE, Codex, Claude Code) |
+
+As approved, three multipliers are manual: every Kiro IDE session by hand
+with per-turn capture (about 245 turns), every rubric judged by the
+developer (464 x 3 hosts, about 1,400 verdicts, ruling D10), and the parity
+gate (six source skills run by hand, 431 rules judged per host). Agents
+cannot shorten any of these. A fourth multiplier is structural: a package
+fix after a run stales every session on every host (T-057, T-064).
+
+## 3. Rulings that remove the multipliers
+
+All four were ruled by the developer on 2026-11-09 in the planning session
+(section 7). Each is a small edit to an approved artifact; phase 0 applies
+the edits, and the artifact is re-approved at the same gate when its
+`.specflow.json` is recovered (section 4).
+
+| ID | Ruling (recommended) | Edits | Fallback |
+|---|---|---|---|
+| R1 | Kiro host runs go through `kiro-cli` engine v3 headless (`--no-interactive --output-format stream-json`, or ACP as `acp_review.py` of intake 00022 already does). It is the same Kiro Agent Server the IDE runs; the Power is installed at `~/.kiro/powers/installed/specflow`; `kiro-cli` has `powers` and `--mode spec`. Kiro IDE stays manual only where IDE behavior is asserted: the three Kiro steps of T-051, T-052, and the "opens as its own spec type" notes for `intake-bugfix` and `shared-dialogue-design-first`. Records keep `host: kiro-ide`, `mode: automated`, and `hostVersion` names kiro-cli and the agent server. Kiro CLI stays "untested, not listed as supported" in the docs (PKG-003.4 unchanged). | 00009 design: Context bullet 4, Eval runners bullet 1, run environment; tasks T-056 adds `run_kiro.py`, T-057 Details. | Power does not load in kiro-cli: the approved plan, all Kiro sessions by hand. |
+| R2 | A model judge scores every `rubric` assertion (`claude -p`, fixed judge prompt, a model other than the one under test where the host is Claude Code). The record stores `judge: model:<id>`. The developer judges by hand every FAIL and a random 10% of PASS per host and session; if more than 1 of 10 sampled verdicts is wrong, that session's rubrics are judged by hand. Amends D10. | 00009 design: Scoring, last bullet; tasks T-056 Details. | D10 as approved: every verdict by hand. |
+| R3 | Parity source runs are headless: the source skill runs on Claude Code through `claude -p` in the developer's normal profile (`--setting-sources user`), invoked by name, on the same fixture and turns. The same judge scores the 431 rules; the developer reviews each per-skill report, not each row. | 00009 design: Parity gate step 2, Data model "run by hand"; tasks T-058 Contract. | Six skills by hand, 431 rows by hand. |
+| R4 | T-066's target `buvis/claude-autopilot` is frozen since 2026-11-01. The repoint item goes to this repository's `docs/dev/project-management/intake/new/` for `plugins/autopilot`. | 00001 tasks T-066 Location, Details, Verify. | None workable; the frozen repo refuses commits. |
+
+Not rulings, only ordering (section 4): the package is frozen before the
+second and third hosts run, so a fix never stales three hosts at once; and
+T-051 and T-052 move after T-057 in `tasks.md` (their `Depends on: T-050`
+lines allow it, SR-TSK-002's topological order holds), so the developer's
+Kiro IDE hours land once, on the frozen package, after the 470 evals have
+found what they find.
+
+## 4. Sequence
+
+Critical path: probes -> phase 0 -> T-050 -> T-056 -> T-054 -> T-053,
+T-081 -> T-057 (Claude Code shakedown, freeze, Codex and kiro-cli runs) ->
+T-051, T-052 -> T-055 -> T-058 -> 00009 review and merge -> T-060 to T-064
+-> tag.
+
+One branch for all of 00009: `feature/specflow-00009`, worktree
+`~/git/src/worktrees/agent-plugins/feature-specflow-00009`. The skill
+serializes tasks: `status` names as `nextTask` the first unchecked task whose
+`Depends on:` tasks are checked, in file order (`specflow_helper/status.py`,
+`next_task`), and SR-IMP-003 allows only that task. A side branch for one
+task would be told to do T-050 like every other, so there are no lanes.
+
+### Probes (first session, before phase 0; developer not needed)
+
+The fallbacks of R1 and of the Codex home are design changes, so both are
+proven before phase 0 writes the rulings into the design. No branch is
+needed: scripts live under `docs/dev/tmp/specflow/probes/`, the results go
+into section 8 of this file, committed on the 00009 branch.
+
+1. Codex: a temporary `CODEX_HOME` under `docs/dev/tmp/specflow/evals/`
+   holding a copy of `~/.codex/auth.json` and the plugin installed by the
+   00008 route (`codex plugin marketplace add <checkout> --json`,
+   `codex plugin add specflow@buvis-agent-plugins --json`); `codex exec
+   --json` answers one spec-workflow status turn on a scratch workspace with
+   its own `git init`. The home is removed afterwards.
+2. kiro-cli v3: with the Power installed at `~/.kiro/powers/installed/specflow`,
+   `kiro-cli chat --no-interactive --output-format stream-json` (or ACP as
+   `acp_review.py` of intake 00022 does) answers the same turn on the same
+   workspace, and the stream shows the Power loaded.
+3. Claude Code: `claude -p --plugin-dir plugins/specflow --output-format
+   stream-json --verbose` with user settings left out (`--setting-sources
+   project,local`, or `--bare` when it accepts `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN`); the
+   init event lists `specflow:spec-workflow`, and the probe records which
+   instruction files still load. Token and nested-run notes: project memory
+   `host-tests-from-inside-a-session`.
+
+A probe that fails is reported with its output; nothing is worked around.
+Its fallback from section 3 then replaces the ruling in phase 0's edits.
+
+### Phase 0: gate and state (same session; developer about 20 minutes)
+
+1. Worktree `feature-specflow-00009` on branch `feature/specflow-00009`
+   from master.
+2. Apply R1 to R4, or the fallbacks the probes forced, to the 00009 design
+   and tasks and the 00001 tasks; move T-051 and T-052 after T-057.
+3. Recover `.specflow.json` for 00009 and 00001 (spec-workflow recovery
+   mode on the receipts in each `qa-log.md`); the developer confirms the
+   requirements approvals as they stand and approves the amended design and
+   tasks in the same answer. Hashes from `validate_spec.py hash --json`.
+4. Commit. `status --json` shows 00009 at `implementation` with `nextTask`
+   T-050, and 00001 at `implementation` blocked on 00009.
+
+### Phase 1: instruments (one branch, tasks in file order, no host runs yet)
+
+Each task is its own fresh session that says "continue spec 00009"; the
+skill resumes from the files.
+
+1. T-050 fixtures + `test_fixtures.py`. Reuse the fixture specs under
+   `tests/specflow/fixtures/sessions/` where one already is the named shape;
+   add only what is missing.
+2. T-056 runners (`run_claude.py`, `run_codex.py`, `run_kiro.py`), scorer,
+   judge, `result.schema.json`, `test_score.py`, `manual-run.md`. The probe
+   scripts are its starting point. Codex exposes no read events, so
+   `filesRead` for Codex is recorded as not measured (design fallback).
+3. T-054 security review + `tests/specflow/security/` + CI step.
+4. T-053, then T-081: the fixture copy from `buvis/calcard-mcp` 00032 (read it
+   for anything non-public before committing), `test_conversion_fixture.py`,
+   CI step, the two sessions and their eval records. Their host runs are the
+   first live runs; they count while the package revision stands.
+
+00001 waits: SR-SKL-007 holds its implementation until 00009 is complete,
+so T-060 to T-062 start in phase 5. The earlier lane E is withdrawn.
+
+### Phase 2: shakedown on Claude Code only (T-057, first half)
+
+1. Run all 59 sessions on `claude-code`, four at a time, with a per-session
+   `--max-budget-usd` cap. Score. Judge rubrics (R2).
+2. Developer: hand-judge every FAIL and the 10% sample.
+3. Fix in one batch: rule text, SKILL.md or reference wording, or the eval
+   when the eval is wrong (say so in the `Outcome:` line). Rerun only
+   Claude Code. Repeat until green. Each rerun is a new `<n>.json`.
+
+### Phase 3: freeze and fan out (T-057 second half, then T-051 to T-058)
+
+1. Record the package tree id (`git rev-parse HEAD:plugins/specflow`) as the
+   frozen revision. No edit under `plugins/specflow/skills/` or to a
+   manifest after this point without returning to phase 2.
+2. In parallel inside T-057: Codex batch (temporary home, removed at batch
+   end) and kiro-cli batch; the two Kiro IDE type notes by the developer.
+   T-053 and T-081 sessions ride in the batches.
+3. Score and judge as in phase 2. A failure that needs a package fix sends
+   all three hosts back to phase 2; an eval or judge error is fixed in
+   place and that session is rerun on the affected hosts only. T-057 is
+   checked.
+4. T-051, then T-052: the developer's Kiro IDE steps on the frozen package;
+   the Codex and Claude Code steps headless through the T-056 runners.
+5. T-055 from the stored records (sizes measured by script; loading compared
+   per phase and profile; Codex marked not measured).
+6. T-058: six source skills headless (R3), judge, six reports, the two
+   maintainer guides.
+
+### Phase 4: close 00009
+
+1. Tick completion criteria; every task carries its `Outcome:` line; CI
+   green with the two new steps; no temporary Codex home left under
+   `docs/dev/tmp/specflow/evals/`.
+2. Fresh session: `/autopilot:review-work-completion` per the recipe in
+   project memory (standalone flags, roster alice, blake, bob as in 00008).
+   Rework, PR, merge to master.
+
+### Phase 5: close 00001 and release
+
+1. Rebase `feature/specflow-00001`; finish T-060 (trial on a throwaway
+   branch), T-061 (`test_docs.py`), T-062 (policy, 0.1.0 entry, pinned
+   install lines with the tag name).
+2. T-063 on a clean checkout of the candidate: `verify_release.py`,
+   unfiltered `check_rules.py`, `generate_marketplace.py --check`, the CI
+   test commands with `PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1`; report with commit and
+   package tree id.
+3. T-064: catch-up over the three sources (report plus cursor moves), install
+   the candidate on the three hosts by the recorded local routes (Kiro IDE
+   by the developer), handoff from the candidate. The 00009 records stay
+   valid when the package diff since the frozen revision touches only
+   `README.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`, and `docs/`. Eight measures with evidence.
+4. Review (fresh session), rework, PR, merge.
+5. T-065 only on the developer's explicit instruction: tag
+   `specflow-v0.1.0` on the master commit that holds the report, the
+   catch-up outputs, and the README row; release notes; fetch the three
+   schema addresses; `git rev-parse specflow-v0.1.0:plugins/specflow` equals
+   the tested tree id.
+6. T-066 (this repository's intake, R4) and T-067 (`buvis/agent-skills`,
+   on the developer's instruction).
+
+## 5. Developer time, in order
+
+| Step | When | Time |
+|---|---|---|
+| Answer R1 to R4; confirm recovered approvals | Phase 0 | 20 min |
+| Hand-judge FAILs and the 10% sample, Claude Code | Phase 2, per round | 1 to 2 h |
+| Kiro IDE subset: T-051 three steps, T-052, two type notes | Phase 3 | 2 to 3 h |
+| Hand-judge FAILs and samples, Codex and Kiro | Phase 3 | 1 to 2 h |
+| Read six parity reports | Phase 3 | 1 h |
+| Two review walkthroughs (only if a finding needs a ruling) | Phases 4, 5 | 0 to 1 h |
+| T-064 Kiro IDE install and handoff step | Phase 5 | 30 min |
+| Say "tag" for T-065; file T-067 | Phase 5 | 15 min |
+
+Everything else is agent work. Agent wall-clock, assuming the probes pass
+and two shakedown rounds: probes, phase 0 and 1 about five days (the tasks
+run one after another), phase 2 and 3 about four, phase 4 and 5 about three.
+
+## 6. Risks
+
+- Codex temporary home: `auth.json` may not be readable from the sandbox,
+  or the copied sign-in may be refused. Probe first; on failure the
+  developer picks the design's fallback (instruction file moved aside,
+  taint recorded, waiver).
+- kiro-cli may not load Powers in headless mode, or may refuse `--trust-tools`
+  for the file tools the skill needs. Probe first; fallback is R1's.
+- Judge variance: the sample rule in R2 catches a judge that drifts; failing
+  runs are kept, reruns are recorded as reruns.
+- `filesRead` on Codex and possibly kiro-cli is unavailable; T-055 records
+  those hosts as not measured, as the design allows.
+- Stored records: 59 sessions x 3 hosts, each with messages and changed
+  files. Expect tens of megabytes in `tests/specflow/evals/results/`.
+- Flaky model output: a session breaks at an `expects` turn and fails every
+  eval on it; rerun once before investigating.
+
+## 7. Unresolved questions
+
+Asked one at a time, in this order.
+
+1. R1: ruled 2026-11-09, yes: kiro-cli v3 headless, Kiro IDE by hand only
+   for the IDE-asserted steps.
+2. R2: ruled 2026-11-09, yes: model judge, developer judges FAILs and a 10%
+   sample; D10 amended.
+3. R3: ruled 2026-11-09, yes: source skills headless through `claude -p`,
+   judged the same way, six reports reviewed.
+4. R4: ruled 2026-11-09, yes: T-066's item goes to this repository's intake
+   for `plugins/autopilot`.
+5. Reviewer roster: ruled 2026-11-09: alice, blake, bob, as in 00008.
+6. Parallel lanes A to E of the first version: withdrawn 2026-11-09 by the
+   planner, no question for the developer. `next_task` and SR-IMP-003
+   serialize the tasks of a spec in file order, and SR-SKL-007 holds 00001
+   until 00009 is complete. Sections 3 and 4 carry the correction.
+
+No question is open. The probe session can start.
+
+## 8. Probe results
+
+Filled by the probe session (section 4), one entry per probe: the command,
+the exit code, the evidence line from the output, pass or fail, and the
+fallback chosen on a fail.

diff --git a/plugins/autopilot/CHANGELOG.md b/plugins/autopilot/CHANGELOG.md
index f61941f..f4c2ac5 100644
--- a/plugins/autopilot/CHANGELOG.md
+++ b/plugins/autopilot/CHANGELOG.md
@@ -4,6 +4,9 @@
 
 ### Added
 
+- **autopilot**: Add the committed controller contract bundle `contracts/controller-v1.json`, its deterministic exporter with `--check` (which refuses symlinked or oversized inputs and a symlinked bundle path), and the README pin of its SHA-256 and installed controller argv.
+- **autopilot**: Add explicit AP00018 successor delivery receipts to the helper map generator. A successor supersedes the exact AP00013 receipts without rewriting them and certifies only the README, CHANGELOG and controller assets it lists, bound to its package revision and the current file bytes, and registers a listed controller asset that has no map row yet. A successor file that is not a valid JSON object, including `null`, is refused. No host execution or certification is claimed.
+- **autopilot**: Document the controller's Python 3.12 floor, commands, implemented operations, private store, receipt capacity, the manual sealed-workflow exit, and bounded-orphan recovery. No host execution or certification is claimed.
 - **autopilot**: Add static host adapters for Claude, Codex and Gemini with a declared-capability contract and generated compatibility bundles. A declared capability is one the adapter implements, so the contract and the bundles are identical on every machine; auth presence appears only in per-run probe evidence, never in a committed artifact. Claude declares identity, delegation, isolation and interception; Codex declares isolation only; Gemini declares none, because neither host implements native session identity or in-session delegation yet. Capability status is a static observation (binary on PATH plus auth presence), never a live invocation. No host execution or certification is claimed.
 - Add stdlib-only, read-only dirty-tree checks and verify log-sink refusal with a descriptor-pinned sink opener, keeping the pinned semantics.
 - Add the advisory local AP00012 review evidence checker that validates policy invariants, closed wire shapes, and every semantic defect against an independent expected context, without certifying host execution.
@@ -30,6 +33,11 @@
 
 ### Fixed
 
+- **autopilot**: bound retained controller staging, rollback, intent and state-publication temporaries to 64 files and 16777216 bytes, refusing bootstrap and owner mutations with `recovery_required` before staging when the full proposal would exceed either limit or a retained artifact is unsafe or unreadable; the state store no longer deletes crash-orphaned publication temporaries.
+- **autopilot**: finish interrupted owner credential cleanup after state publication, while rejecting missing precommit evidence and corrupt remaining files.
+- **autopilot**: report the current durable revision when snapshots refuse pending credential intents, without reconciling them.
+- **autopilot**: rotate owner leases and operator credentials recoverably, retaining exact receipt replay without restoring retired mutation authority.
+- **autopilot**: restore transaction publication guard checks at every durability boundary, preserving exact state and backup rollback when evidence changes.
 - **autopilot**: `--verify` accepts a relative `--project-root` again and judges it exactly as its absolute spelling, instead of refusing every output path it resolves with `unsafe-artifact-path`.
 - **autopilot**: `--verify` proves both its log sink and its result-artifact sink openable before it spawns the child and judges each sink by the file it actually opened; when the spawn fails, an existing log and result artifact stay byte-identical and a log this run created is removed; it reports a sink open, write or close failure as its own controlled error with the child killed, stops the child's leftover processes when a sink fails late, and removes only a leaf it created; `--export-policy --out` refuses a reader-less FIFO instead of hanging and refuses up front where `O_NOFOLLOW` is missing; the log sink judges containment before it reads a Git pointer.
 - **autopilot**: `--verify` removes only the result artifact that its own failed run created; a file that took the artifact's name during the run, a leaf that became a directory, or a parent that became a symlink is left untouched and never replaces the run's own reported failure.
diff --git a/plugins/autopilot/README.md b/plugins/autopilot/README.md
index 5a8cb0c..1299435 100644
--- a/plugins/autopilot/README.md
+++ b/plugins/autopilot/README.md
@@ -321,3 +321,118 @@ This package is not published to any marketplace. No installation is supported
 yet; the historical Install and Update sections describe the source plugin.
 Real-host evidence is unavailable: the helpers are tested in a sandbox only, and
 no host profile is certified.
+
+## Controller contract bundle
+
+`contracts/controller-v1.json` pins the controller protocol, package version,
+schema and fixture digests, operations and capabilities. Maintainers regenerate
+it in a repository checkout with the unshipped exporter
+`tools/autopilot/export-controller-contract.py`, whose check mode verifies it.
+Its `sha256sum` from the repository root is:
+
+```text
+7bef27adaee3a786f6d0ce1e91176492d1012e67eae6ab2500e31150136eaa98  plugins/autopilot/contracts/controller-v1.json
+```
+
+The installed controller argv is:
+
+```json
+["python3", "<installed-plugin-root>/controller/main.py"]
+```
+
+### Runtime and commands
+
+The controller needs Python 3.12 or newer. It uses the standard library only.
+Run it with the installed argv and one of these commands:
+
+```text
+--json contract
+--json snapshot --project-root PATH
+--json apply --project-root PATH --request FILE [--actor-file PATH]
+```
+
+Exit code 0 means success. Exit code 1 means a structured rejection. Exit code
+2 means argument misuse. Callers must bound execution time.
+
+### Implemented operations
+
+The controller implements four operations: `workflow.open`, `owner.acquire`,
+`owner.release` and `owner.recover`. It advertises one capability,
+`workflow.core.v1`. All later operation families are unavailable until
+implemented: policy, prd, task, lane, job, review, custody, verification,
+phase, artifact and records. A request for one of them returns
+`missing_capability` and writes nothing.
+
+### Private store
+
+The controller keeps its state in `<project-root>/.autopilot/controller/`, a
+private directory with mode 0700. It holds `state.json`, `state.json.bak`,
+`state.json.lock` and `actors/`. Credentials are files with mode 0600. Their
+contents never appear in responses or logs.
+
+### Receipt capacity
+
+Normal receipt admission stops at 4094 entries. Two more slots are reserved
+for `owner.release` and `owner.recover`. These may clear an active owner at
+saturation, but they never acquire a new one. At 4096 entries the workflow is
+sealed against all new mutations. Exact receipt retrieval and `snapshot` stay
+available.
+
+### Leave a sealed workflow
+
+No archival or state removal runs automatically. Follow these steps by hand,
+in order:
+
+1. Finish or reconcile jobs. This controller supports no jobs yet.
+2. Release or recover ownership with `owner.release` or `owner.recover`. These
+   use the reserve capacity.
+3. Run `snapshot` and verify that the owner is null.
+4. Copy the entire private controller directory to a private offline archive.
+   Verify every file hash.
+5. Rename the original private directory into a sibling private archive named
+   by the workflow ID.
+6. Open a new workflow with `workflow.open` at the fixed empty controller path.
+
+Never delete the archive. Archived state, credentials, receipts and schema stay
+replayable. To replay them, take the new workflow offline and place the
+original directory back at its original project binding. Never merge
+identities.
+
+### Bounded orphans
+
+A crash can leave controller-owned staging, rollback and temporary files. These
+are credential `.stage` and `.rollback` files under `actors/`, plus
+`.intent-*.tmp` files and state publication `.state.json.autopilot-*.tmp` files
+in the private directory. The controller limits them to 64 files and 16777216
+bytes in total. It refuses a bootstrap or owner mutation with
+`recovery_required`, and changes nothing, when the full proposal would exceed
+either limit. It does the same when it finds an unsafe or unreadable owned
+artifact. The controller never deletes an orphan.
+
+The admitted proposal leaves out the transient state publication temporaries.
+A crash at a publication boundary can therefore keep up to two more
+temporaries, each up to the size of the state. The next mutation then refuses.
+
+### Recover from orphans
+
+Archive-based recovery requires the operator to take the workflow offline,
+retain all bytes, and restore the verified consistent state and credentials
+before retry. Follow these steps in order:
+
+1. Stop all callers.
+2. Copy the private directory to a private offline archive. Verify every file
+   hash.
+3. Move only the identified orphan files into that archive. Never delete them.
+4. Keep `state.json`, `state.json.bak`, the credentials and
+   `credential-intent.json` in place.
+5. Run `snapshot` and verify that the state is unchanged.
+6. Resume the callers.
+
+A pending `credential-intent.json` makes `snapshot` report
+`recovery_required`. Only the identical original request, with its original
+credential, finishes it.
+
+### Host support
+
+This section covers the local controller only. It claims no real host support
+and no host certification. Host execution needs separate probe evidence.

+    def inspect(self, path: Path) -> int:

+def admit_staging(layout: PrivateLayout, proposed: list[bytes]) -> None:
+    """Refuse a staging set that, with retained orphans, exceeds either budget.
+
+    Orphans are never deleted here; an unsafe or unreadable one refuses.
+    """
+    count, size = len(proposed), sum(len(raw) for raw in proposed)
+    layout.verify()
+    for parent, pattern in ((layout.private, PRIVATE_ARTIFACT), (layout.actors, ACTOR_ARTIFACT)):
+        for name in os.listdir(layout.directories[parent]):

+                count += 1
+                size += layout.inspect(parent / name)

+        raise StateIOError("staging budget exhausted")

diff --git a/plugins/autopilot/controller/autopilot_state/owner.py b/plugins/autopilot/controller/autopilot_state/owner.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..afb2ad8
--- /dev/null
+++ b/plugins/autopilot/controller/autopilot_state/owner.py
@@ -0,0 +1,273 @@
+"""Owner lease transitions under the controller's existing exclusive lock."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import copy
+import hmac
+import os
+import re
+import secrets
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from . import actors, schema
+from .store import StateIOError, StateStore
+
+INTENT_KEYS = {"version", "request", "request_digest", "old_revision",
+               "old_state_digest", "old_actor", "old_actors", "old_owner",
+               "candidate", "response", "receipt", "credentials"}
+
+
+def transition(current: dict, request: dict, operator: dict,
+               owner: dict | None, layout: actors.PrivateLayout) -> tuple[dict, dict]:
+    candidate = copy.deepcopy(current)
+    candidate["revision"] += 1
+    candidate["lease_epoch"] += 1
+    candidate["actors"] = {operator["actor_id"]: operator}
+    candidate["owner"] = None
+    result = {"actor_id": operator["actor_id"], "lease_epoch": candidate["lease_epoch"],
+              "operator_actor_file": str(layout.actors / "operator.json")}
+    if owner is not None:
+        candidate["actors"][owner["actor_id"]] = owner
+        candidate["owner"] = {"actor_id": owner["actor_id"],
+                              "lease_epoch": candidate["lease_epoch"], **request["payload"]}
+        result.update(actor_id=owner["actor_id"],
+                      actor_file=str(layout.actors / (owner["actor_id"] + ".json")))
+    completed = {"ok": True, "revision": candidate["revision"], "result": result,
+                 "error_code": None, "retryable": False}
+    candidate["receipts"][request["request_id"]] = {
+        "request_digest": actors.digest(actors.canonical(request)),
+        "authorizing_actor": current["actors"][request["actor_id"]], "response": completed}
+    emergency = current["owner"] is not None and request["operation"] != "owner.acquire"
+    return actors.admit(candidate, completed, emergency=emergency), completed
+
+
+def prepare(request: dict, current: dict, layout: actors.PrivateLayout) -> dict:
+    old_operator = next(row for row in current["actors"].values() if row["role"] == "operator")
+    old_raw = layout.read(layout.actors / "operator.json", 65536)
+    credentials, staged = [], []
+    descriptors = {}
+    roles = ("operator", "owner") if request["operation"] == "owner.acquire" else ("operator",)
+    for role in roles:
+        actor_id = old_operator["actor_id"] if role == "operator" else "owner-" + secrets.token_hex(16)
+        credential = {"actor_id": actor_id, "project_id": current["project_id"],
+                      "workflow_id": current["workflow_id"], "role": role,
+                      "lease_epoch": current["lease_epoch"] + 1,
+                      "native_session_id": (request["payload"]["native_session_id"]
+                                            if role == "owner" else None),
+                      "secret": secrets.token_urlsafe(32)}
+        raw = actors.canonical(credential)
+        descriptor = actors.credential_descriptor(raw)
+        descriptors[role] = descriptor
+        entry = {"stage": f".{role}-{secrets.token_hex(16)}.stage",
+                 "final": "operator.json" if role == "operator" else actor_id + ".json",
+                 "digest": actors.digest(raw), "actor": descriptor, "previous": None}
+        staged.append((entry["stage"], raw))
+        if role == "operator":
+            entry["previous"] = {"stage": f".operator-{secrets.token_hex(16)}.rollback",
+                                 "digest": actors.digest(old_raw), "actor": old_operator}
+            staged.append((entry["previous"]["stage"], old_raw))
+        credentials.append(entry)
+    candidate, completed = transition(current, request, descriptors["operator"],
+                                       descriptors.get("owner"), layout)
+    receipt = candidate["receipts"][request["request_id"]]
+    intent = {"version": 1, "request": request, "request_digest": receipt["request_digest"],
+              "old_revision": current["revision"],
+              "old_state_digest": actors.digest(actors.canonical(current)),
+              "old_actor": current["actors"][request["actor_id"]],
+              "old_actors": current["actors"], "old_owner": current["owner"],
+              "candidate": candidate, "response": completed, "receipt": receipt,
+              "credentials": credentials}
+    validate_intent(intent, layout)
+    encoded = actors.canonical(intent)
+    if len(encoded) > actors.INTENT_LIMIT:
+        raise StateIOError("intent exceeds resource limit")
+    actors.admit_staging(layout, [raw for _, raw in staged] + [encoded])
+    for name, raw in staged:
+        layout.write_new(layout.actors / name, raw)
+    temporary = layout.private / f".intent-{secrets.token_hex(16)}.tmp"
+    layout.write_new(temporary, encoded)
+    layout.publish(temporary, layout.private / "credential-intent.json")
+    return intent
+
+
+def validate_intent(intent: object, layout: actors.PrivateLayout) -> dict:
+    from . import protocol
+
+    schema._object(intent, INTENT_KEYS)
+    if type(intent["version"]) is not int or intent["version"] != 1:
+        raise StateIOError("invalid owner intent")
+    request = protocol.parse_request(actors.canonical(intent["request"]), {"reserved_operations": {}})
+    if request["operation"] not in protocol.OWNER_OPERATIONS:
+        raise StateIOError("invalid owner operation")
+    candidate = schema.validate_state(intent["candidate"])
+    old = copy.deepcopy(candidate)
+    old["revision"] = intent["old_revision"]
+    old["lease_epoch"] = request["lease_epoch"]
+    old["actors"] = intent["old_actors"]
+    old["owner"] = intent["old_owner"]
+    del old["receipts"][request["request_id"]]
+    old = schema.validate_state(old)
+    authorizer = old["actors"][request["actor_id"]]
+    expected_role = "owner" if request["operation"] == "owner.release" else "operator"
+    if (old["repo_root"] != str(layout.root)
+            or old["project_id"] != protocol.project_identity(layout.root)
+            or request["expected_revision"] != old["revision"]
+            or intent["old_state_digest"] != actors.digest(actors.canonical(old))
+            or intent["old_actor"] != authorizer or authorizer["role"] != expected_role
+            or (request["operation"] == "owner.acquire" and old["owner"] is not None)
+            or (request["operation"] == "owner.recover" and request["payload"]["reconciled_job_ids"])):
+        raise StateIOError("inconsistent owner predecessor")
+    protocol.actor_binding(request, authorizer, old["revision"])
+    descriptors = _intent_credentials(intent, request, old)
+    expected, completed = transition(old, request, descriptors["operator"],
+                                     descriptors.get("owner"), layout)
+    receipt = expected["receipts"][request["request_id"]]
+    if (candidate != expected or intent["response"] != completed or intent["receipt"] != receipt
+            or intent["request_digest"] != receipt["request_digest"]):
+        raise StateIOError("inconsistent owner intent")
+    return intent
+
+
+def _intent_credentials(intent: dict, request: dict, old: dict) -> dict:
+    entries = intent["credentials"]
+    roles = ["operator", "owner"] if request["operation"] == "owner.acquire" else ["operator"]
+    if not isinstance(entries, list) or len(entries) != len(roles):
+        raise StateIOError("invalid owner credentials")
+    descriptors, names = {}, set()
+    old_operator = next(row for row in old["actors"].values() if row["role"] == "operator")
+    for entry, role in zip(entries, roles):
+        schema._object(entry, {"stage", "final", "digest", "actor", "previous"})
+        descriptor = schema._actor(entry["actor"])
+        schema._digest(entry["digest"])
+        final = "operator.json" if role == "operator" else descriptor["actor_id"] + ".json"
+        if (descriptor["role"] != role or entry["final"] != final
+                or descriptor["lease_epoch"] != old["lease_epoch"] + 1
+                or any(descriptor[key] != old[key] for key in ("project_id", "workflow_id"))
+                or re.fullmatch(r"\." + role + r"-[0-9a-f]{32}\.stage", entry["stage"]) is None):
+            raise StateIOError("inconsistent owner credential")
+        if role == "operator":
+            previous = schema._object(entry["previous"], {"stage", "digest", "actor"})
+            schema._digest(previous["digest"])
+            if (descriptor["actor_id"] != old_operator["actor_id"]
+                    or descriptor["secret_digest"] == old_operator["secret_digest"]
+                    or previous["actor"] != old_operator
+                    or re.fullmatch(r"\.operator-[0-9a-f]{32}\.rollback", previous["stage"]) is None):
+                raise StateIOError("invalid operator rotation")
+            names.add(previous["stage"])
+        elif (entry["previous"] is not None
+              or re.fullmatch(r"owner-[0-9a-f]{32}", descriptor["actor_id"]) is None
+              or descriptor["actor_id"] in old["actors"]
+              or descriptor["native_session_id"] != request["payload"]["native_session_id"]):
+            raise StateIOError("invalid owner issuance")
+        if entry["stage"] in names:
+            raise StateIOError("duplicate owner stage")
+        names.add(entry["stage"])
+        descriptors[role] = descriptor
+    return descriptors
+
+
+def verify_file(layout: actors.PrivateLayout, path: Path, entry: dict) -> None:
+    raw = layout.read(path, 65536)
+    if (not hmac.compare_digest(actors.digest(raw), entry["digest"])
+            or actors.credential_descriptor(raw) != entry["actor"]):
+        raise StateIOError("credential evidence does not match intent")
+
+
+def finish_intent(request: dict, actor_file: Path | None, intent: dict,
+                  layout: actors.PrivateLayout, store: StateStore, current: dict | None) -> dict:
+    from . import protocol
+
+    revision = 0 if current is None else current["revision"]
+    if request != intent["request"]:
+        raise protocol.ProtocolError("recovery_required", revision)
+    # A rotated operator can recover its lost acknowledgement at the same path.
+    actors.authenticate_receipt(actor_file, intent["old_actor"], intent["candidate"], layout)
+    validate_intent(intent, layout)
+    candidate = intent["candidate"]
+    if current is None or (current != candidate and (
+            current["revision"] != intent["old_revision"]
+            or actors.digest(actors.canonical(current)) != intent["old_state_digest"])):
+        raise StateIOError("state does not match owner intent")
+    _publish_credentials(intent, layout, current, candidate)
+
+    def guard() -> None:
+        layout.verify()
+        for entry in intent["credentials"]:
+            verify_file(layout, layout.actors / entry["final"], entry)
+
+    guard()
+    if current != candidate:
+        store._transaction_locked(lambda unused: candidate, expected_revision=intent["old_revision"],
+                                  publication_guard=guard)
+    guard()
+    for entry in intent["credentials"]:
+        layout.remove(layout.actors / entry["stage"])
+        if entry["previous"] is not None:
+            layout.remove(layout.actors / entry["previous"]["stage"])
+    os.fsync(layout.directories[layout.actors])
+    layout.remove(layout.private / "credential-intent.json")
+    os.fsync(layout.directories[layout.private])
+    return intent["response"]
+
+
+def _publish_credentials(intent: dict, layout: actors.PrivateLayout,
+                         current: dict, candidate: dict) -> None:
+    pending = []
+    # Validate every piece of evidence before publishing any credential.
+    for entry in intent["credentials"]:
+        stage, final = layout.actors / entry["stage"], layout.actors / entry["final"]
+        previous = entry["previous"]
+        if previous is not None and (
+                current != candidate or layout.exists(layout.actors / previous["stage"])):
+            verify_file(layout, layout.actors / previous["stage"], previous)
+        if layout.exists(stage):
+            verify_file(layout, stage, entry)
+        if layout.exists(final):
+            raw = layout.read(final, 65536)
+            if actors.digest(raw) == entry["digest"]:
+                verify_file(layout, final, entry)
+                continue
+            if previous is None or current == candidate:
+                raise StateIOError("published credential does not match intent")
+            verify_file(layout, final, previous)
+        elif current == candidate or previous is not None:
+            raise StateIOError("committed credential missing")
+        verify_file(layout, stage, entry)
+        pending.append((stage, final))
+    for stage, final in pending:
+        layout.verify()
+        os.replace(stage.name, final.name, src_dir_fd=layout.directories[layout.actors],
+                   dst_dir_fd=layout.directories[layout.actors])
+        layout.verify()
+        os.fsync(layout.directories[layout.actors])
+
+
+def apply_locked(request: dict, actor_file: Path | None, current: dict,
+                 layout: actors.PrivateLayout, store: StateStore) -> dict:
+    from . import protocol
+
+    revision = current["revision"]
+    receipt = current["receipts"].get(request["request_id"])
+    if receipt is not None:
+        protocol.actor_binding(request, receipt["authorizing_actor"], revision)
+        actors.authenticate_receipt(actor_file, receipt["authorizing_actor"], current, layout)
+        if receipt["request_digest"] != actors.digest(actors.canonical(request)):
+            raise protocol.ProtocolError("invalid_request", revision)
+        actors.verify_operator(layout, current)
+        return receipt["response"]
+    descriptor = current["actors"].get(request["actor_id"])
+    role = "owner" if request["operation"] == "owner.release" else "operator"
+    if descriptor is None or descriptor["role"] != role:
+        raise protocol.ProtocolError("wrong_binding", revision)
+    protocol.actor_binding(request, descriptor, revision)
+    actors.authenticate(actor_file, descriptor, layout)
+    if request["expected_revision"] != revision:
+        raise protocol.ProtocolError("revision_conflict", revision)
+    if request["operation"] == "owner.acquire" and current["owner"] is not None:
+        raise protocol.ProtocolError("wrong_binding", revision)
+    if request["operation"] == "owner.recover" and (
+            request["payload"]["reconciled_job_ids"] or current["workflow"]["jobs"]):
+        raise protocol.ProtocolError("rejected_evidence", revision)
+    actors.verify_operator(layout, current)
+    intent = prepare(request, current, layout)
+    return finish_intent(request, actor_file, intent, layout, store, current)

diff --git a/tests/autopilot/test_controller_export.py b/tests/autopilot/test_controller_export.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..70f25f6
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/autopilot/test_controller_export.py
@@ -0,0 +1,610 @@
+"""Exported controller bundle, its pins, and the copy-only installed package."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import hashlib
+import json
+import os
+import re
+import shutil
+import stat
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import unittest
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from controller_cli_support import (
+    ControllerCLITest,
+    canonical,
+    cli,
+    fresh_request,
+    private_path,
+    strict_json,
+    tree,
+)
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
+PLUGIN = ROOT / "plugins" / "autopilot"
+BUNDLE_RELATIVE = "plugins/autopilot/contracts/controller-v1.json"
+BUNDLE = ROOT / BUNDLE_RELATIVE
+README = PLUGIN / "README.md"
+EXPORTER = ROOT / "tools" / "autopilot" / "export-controller-contract.py"
+TARGET = Path("contracts") / "controller-v1.json"
+SCHEMA = Path("contracts") / "controller" / "workflow-v1.json"
+FIXTURES = Path("contracts") / "controller" / "fixtures-v1.json"
+BUNDLE_KEYS = {
+    "protocol_major",
+    "package_version",
+    "schema_digest",
+    "fixture_digest",
+    "operations",
+    "capabilities",
+}
+OPERATIONS = {"workflow.open", "owner.acquire", "owner.release", "owner.recover"}
+CAPABILITIES = {"workflow.core.v1"}
+INSTALLED_ARGV = '["python3", "<installed-plugin-root>/controller/main.py"]'
+LIMIT = 16777216
+HEX = re.compile(r"[0-9a-f]{64}")
+BUILD = r"[0-9A-Za-z-]+(\.[0-9A-Za-z-]+)*"
+NEGATION = re.compile(r"\b(?:not|never|avoid)\b|n't", re.IGNORECASE)
+
+# Runs a script with the stdlib only (-I -S), denying every read of the source
+# checkout and the author home outside this test's sandbox and the interpreter.
+GUARD = """
+import os
+import runpy
+import sys
+
+PRIVATE = {private!r}
+ALLOWED = [os.path.realpath(path) for path in ({allowed!r}, sys.prefix,
+           sys.base_prefix, sys.exec_prefix, sys.base_exec_prefix)]
+
+
+def inside(path, roots):
+    return any(path == root or path.startswith(root.rstrip(os.sep) + os.sep)
+               for root in roots)
+
+
+def guard(event, args):
+    if event not in ("open", "os.listdir", "os.scandir") or not args:
+        return
+    if args[0] is None or isinstance(args[0], int):
+        return
+    path = os.path.realpath(os.fsdecode(args[0]))
+    if inside(path, PRIVATE) and not inside(path, ALLOWED):
+        raise PermissionError("isolated test denies " + path)
+
+
+sys.addaudithook(guard)
+script = sys.argv[1]
+sys.argv = sys.argv[1:]
+sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(script)))
+runpy.run_path(script, run_name="__main__")
+"""
+
+
+def digest(path: Path) -> str:
+    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
+
+
+def stable_tree(root: Path) -> dict:
+    """tree() with directory link counts masked; APFS counts entries in them."""
+    return {
+        key: (kind, mode, None if stat.S_ISDIR(kind) else links, content)
+        for key, (kind, mode, links, content) in tree(root).items()
+    }
+
+
+def heading_levels(lines: list[str]) -> list[int]:
+    levels, fenced = [], False
+    for line in lines:
+        if line.lstrip().startswith("```"):
+            fenced = not fenced
+        match = None if fenced else re.match(r"(#{1,6}) ", line)
+        levels.append(len(match.group(1)) if match else 0)
+    return levels
+
+
+def heading_section(text: str, needle: str) -> list[str]:
+    """Lines of the Markdown heading section that contains needle."""
+    lines = text.splitlines()
+    levels = heading_levels(lines)
+    index = next(i for i, line in enumerate(lines) if needle in line)
+    start = next((i for i in range(index, -1, -1) if levels[i]), 0)
+    depth = levels[start] or 6
+    end = next(
+        (i for i in range(start + 1, len(lines)) if 0 < levels[i] <= depth),
+        len(lines),
+    )
+    return lines[start:end]
+
+
+def copy_plugin(destination: Path) -> Path:
+    shutil.copytree(
+        PLUGIN,
+        destination,
+        symlinks=True,
+        ignore=shutil.ignore_patterns("__pycache__", "*.pyc"),
+    )
+    return destination
+
+
+class BundleAssertions(unittest.TestCase):
+    def assert_runtime_matches(self, runtime: object, bundle: dict) -> None:
+        self.assertIsInstance(runtime, dict)
+        for key in ("protocol_major", "schema_digest", "fixture_digest"):
+            self.assertEqual(runtime[key], bundle[key], key)
+        self.assertIs(type(runtime["protocol_major"]), int)
+        version = runtime["package_version"]
+        self.assertIsInstance(version, str)
+        if version != bundle["package_version"]:
+            prefix = bundle["package_version"] + "+"
+            self.assertTrue(version.startswith(prefix), version)
+            self.assertRegex(version[len(prefix) :], "^" + BUILD + "$")
+        for key in ("operations", "capabilities"):
+            self.assertIsInstance(runtime[key], list)
+            self.assertLessEqual(set(bundle[key]), set(runtime[key]), key)
+
+
+class IsolatedCase(ControllerCLITest, BundleAssertions):
+    def setUp(self) -> None:
+        super().setUp()
+        for name in ("home", "tmp"):
+            (self.base / name).mkdir()
+        self.cwd = self.base / "cwd"
+        live = private_path(self.cwd)
+        live.mkdir(parents=True)
+        (live / "state.json").write_bytes(canonical({"revision": 7, "live": True}))
+        # Live workflow state in the working directory is unreadable to every run.
+        (self.cwd / ".autopilot").chmod(0o000)
+        self.addCleanup((self.cwd / ".autopilot").chmod, 0o700)
+        self.env = {
+            "HOME": str(self.base / "home"),
+            "TMPDIR": str(self.base / "tmp"),
+            "PATH": "/usr/bin:/bin",
+        }
+
+    def run_isolated(
+        self, script: Path, arguments: list[str]
+    ) -> subprocess.CompletedProcess:
+        code = GUARD.format(
+            private=[str(ROOT), str(Path.home().resolve())], allowed=str(self.base)
+        )
+        return subprocess.run(
+            [sys.executable, "-I", "-S", "-B", "-c", code, str(script), *arguments],
+            cwd=self.cwd,
+            env=self.env,
+            capture_output=True,
+            timeout=30,
+            check=False,
+        )
+
+    def assert_exit(self, completed: subprocess.CompletedProcess, code: int) -> None:
+        self.assertEqual(
+            completed.returncode,
+            code,
+            completed.stderr.decode("utf-8", errors="replace"),
+        )
+
+
+class ControllerBundleReproducibleTest(IsolatedCase):
+    def setUp(self) -> None:
+        super().setUp()
+        mirror = self.base / "checkout copy"
+        self.plugin = copy_plugin(mirror / "plugins" / "autopilot")
+        self.exporter = mirror / "tools" / "autopilot" / EXPORTER.name
+        self.exporter.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
+        shutil.copy2(EXPORTER, self.exporter)
+        self.committed = BUNDLE.read_bytes()
+
+    def export(self, *arguments: str) -> subprocess.CompletedProcess:
+        return self.run_isolated(self.exporter, list(arguments))
+
+    def test_controller_bundle_reproducible_default_export_writes_committed_bytes(
+        self,
+    ) -> None:
+        target = self.plugin / TARGET
+        target.unlink()
+        before, cwd = stable_tree(self.plugin), tree(self.cwd)
+        self.assert_exit(self.export(), 0)
+        self.assertEqual(target.read_bytes(), self.committed)
+        info = target.lstat()
+        self.assertTrue(stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode))
+        self.assertEqual(info.st_nlink, 1)
+        # No permission bit beyond the committed sibling contracts' bits.
+        sibling = stat.S_IMODE((self.plugin / SCHEMA).lstat().st_mode)
+        mode = stat.S_IMODE(info.st_mode)
+        self.assertEqual(mode & ~sibling, 0, oct(mode))
+        self.assertTrue(mode & stat.S_IRUSR, oct(mode))
+        after = stable_tree(self.plugin)
+        self.assertEqual(
+            {key: value for key, value in after.items() if key != str(TARGET)}, before
+        )
+        self.assert_exit(self.export(), 0)
+        self.assert_exit(self.export("--check"), 0)
+        self.assertEqual(stable_tree(self.plugin), after)
+        self.assertEqual(tree(self.cwd), cwd)
+
+    def test_controller_bundle_reproducible_export_replaces_symlink_check_rejects_it(
+        self,
+    ) -> None:
+        target = self.plugin / TARGET
+        outside = self.base / "outside.json"
+        victim = b'{"victim": true}\n'
+        outside.write_bytes(victim)
+        target.unlink()
+        target.symlink_to(outside)
+        self.assert_exit(self.export(), 0)
+        self.assertEqual(outside.read_bytes(), victim)
+        info = target.lstat()
+        self.assertTrue(stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode))
+        self.assertEqual(info.st_nlink, 1)
+        self.assertEqual(target.read_bytes(), self.committed)
+        # A symlinked bundle is rejected even when its bytes match.
+        outside.write_bytes(self.committed)
+        target.unlink()
+        target.symlink_to(outside)
+        before = stable_tree(self.base)
+        self.assert_exit(self.export("--check"), 1)
+        self.assertEqual(stable_tree(self.base), before)
+
+    def test_controller_bundle_reproducible_rejects_unknown_flags_without_writing(
+        self,
+    ) -> None:
+        target = self.plugin / TARGET
+        target.unlink()
+        misuses = (

+        self.assertEqual((self.plugin / TARGET).read_bytes(), self.committed)

+    def test_controller_bundle_reproducible_export_reads_assets_of_given_plugin_root(
+        self,
+    ) -> None:
+        other = copy_plugin(self.base / "relocated" / "autopilot")
+        manifest = json.loads((other / "plugin.json").read_bytes())
+        manifest["version"] = "9.8.7"
+        (other / "plugin.json").write_text(json.dumps(manifest, indent=2) + "\n")
+        (other / FIXTURES).write_bytes((other / FIXTURES).read_bytes() + b"\n")
+        default_before = tree(self.plugin)
+        self.assert_exit(self.export("--check", "--plugin-root", str(other)), 1)
+        self.assertEqual((other / TARGET).read_bytes(), self.committed)
+        self.assert_exit(self.export("--plugin-root", str(other)), 0)
+        exported = strict_json((other / TARGET).read_bytes())
+        committed = strict_json(self.committed)
+        self.assertEqual(exported["package_version"], "9.8.7")
+        self.assertEqual(exported["fixture_digest"], digest(other / FIXTURES))
+        self.assertNotEqual(exported["fixture_digest"], committed["fixture_digest"])
+        self.assertEqual(exported["schema_digest"], committed["schema_digest"])
+        self.assertEqual(exported["schema_digest"], digest(other / SCHEMA))
+        for key in ("protocol_major", "operations", "capabilities"):
+            self.assertEqual(exported[key], committed[key], key)
+        self.assert_exit(self.export("--check", "--plugin-root", str(other)), 0)
+        self.assertEqual(tree(self.plugin), default_before)
+        self.assert_exit(self.export("--check"), 0)
+        (other / SCHEMA).write_bytes((other / SCHEMA).read_bytes() + b"\n")
+        stale = (other / TARGET).read_bytes()
+        self.assert_exit(self.export("--check", "--plugin-root", str(other)), 1)
+        self.assertEqual((other / TARGET).read_bytes(), stale)
+        self.assert_exit(self.export("--plugin-root", str(other)), 0)
+        rewritten = strict_json((other / TARGET).read_bytes())
+        self.assertEqual(rewritten["schema_digest"], digest(other / SCHEMA))
+        self.assertNotEqual(rewritten["schema_digest"], committed["schema_digest"])
+        self.assertEqual(rewritten["fixture_digest"], exported["fixture_digest"])
+        self.assert_exit(self.export("--check", "--plugin-root", str(other)), 0)

+    def test_controller_bundle_reproducible_check_rejects_missing_and_near_miss_bundles(
+        self,
+    ) -> None:
+        target = self.plugin / TARGET
+        bundle = strict_json(self.committed)
+        schema_digest = bundle["schema_digest"].encode()
+        fixture = bundle["fixture_digest"].encode()
+        version = json.dumps(bundle["package_version"]).encode()
+        same_length = {
+            "flipped fixture digest": self.committed.replace(
+                fixture, fixture[:-1] + (b"1" if fixture.endswith(b"0") else b"0")
+            ),
+            "renamed operation": self.committed.replace(
+                b'"workflow.open"', b'"workflow.shut"'
+            ),
+            "drifted version": self.committed.replace(
+                version,
+                version[:-2] + (b"1" if version[-2:-1] == b"0" else b"0") + b'"',
+                1,
+            ),
+        }
+        variants = {
+            "missing": None,
+            "trailing newline": self.committed + b"\n",
+            "truncated": self.committed[:-1],
+            "stale digest": self.committed.replace(schema_digest, b"0" * 64),
+        } | same_length
+        for name, payload in variants.items():
+            with self.subTest(variant=name):
+                if payload is None:
+                    target.unlink()
+                else:
+                    self.assertNotEqual(payload, self.committed)
+                    target.write_bytes(payload)
+                if name in same_length:
+                    self.assertEqual(len(payload), len(self.committed))
+                    self.assertNotEqual(strict_json(payload), bundle)
+                before = tree(self.plugin)
+                self.assert_exit(self.export("--check"), 1)
+                self.assertEqual(tree(self.plugin), before)
+                self.assertEqual(target.exists(), payload is not None)
+                target.write_bytes(self.committed)
+                self.assert_exit(self.export("--check"), 0)
+

+        moved.parent.mkdir()

+        before = (stable_tree(self.plugin), stable_tree(moved))
+        self.assert_exit(self.export("--check"), 1)
+        self.assertEqual((stable_tree(self.plugin), stable_tree(moved)), before)
+        # Export would otherwise write the bundle through the link, outside the root.
+        (moved / TARGET.name).unlink()
+        before = (stable_tree(self.plugin), stable_tree(moved))
+        self.assertNotEqual(self.export().returncode, 0)
+        self.assertEqual((stable_tree(self.plugin), stable_tree(moved)), before)
+        self.assertFalse(os.path.lexists(moved / TARGET.name))
+        self.assertTrue(contracts.is_symlink())

+class ControllerWithoutUpperLayersTest(IsolatedCase):
+    def test_controller_without_upper_layers_guard_denies_checkout_and_author_home(
+        self,
+    ) -> None:
+        probe = self.base / "probe" / "probe.py"
+        probe.parent.mkdir()
+        probe.write_text(
+            "import json, sys\nfrom pathlib import Path\n"
+            "print(json.dumps(sys.path))\nPath(sys.argv[1]).read_bytes()\n"
+        )
+        allowed = self.base / "inside.txt"
+        allowed.write_bytes(b"sandbox")
+        completed = self.run_isolated(probe, [str(allowed)])
+        self.assert_exit(completed, 0)
+        paths = json.loads(completed.stdout.splitlines()[0])
+        self.assertEqual(Path(paths[0]), probe.parent)
+        for entry in paths:
+            self.assertFalse(Path(entry).resolve().is_relative_to(ROOT), entry)
+            self.assertNotIn("site-packages", entry)
+        for denied in (
+            PLUGIN / "plugin.json",
+            self.cwd / ".autopilot" / "controller" / "state.json",
+            Path.home() / ".claude" / "settings.json",
+        ):
+            with self.subTest(denied=denied):
+                completed = self.run_isolated(probe, [str(denied)])
+                self.assertNotEqual(completed.returncode, 0)
+                self.assertIn(b"PermissionError", completed.stderr)

+    def exercise_install(self, install: Path) -> None:
+        copy_plugin(install)
+        before, cwd = tree(install), tree(self.cwd)
+        main = install / "controller" / "main.py"
+        bundle = strict_json((install / TARGET).read_bytes())
+        plain = subprocess.run(
+            [sys.executable, "-B", str(main), "--json", "contract"],
+            cwd=self.cwd,
+            env=self.env,
+            capture_output=True,
+            timeout=30,
+            check=False,
+        )
+        self.assert_exit(plain, 0)
+        self.assert_runtime_matches(strict_json(plain.stdout), bundle)
+        guarded = self.run_isolated(main, ["--json", "contract"])
+        self.assert_exit(guarded, 0)
+        self.assertEqual(strict_json(guarded.stdout), strict_json(plain.stdout))
+        request = fresh_request(self.root)
+        opened = self.run_isolated(
+            main,
+            [
+                "--json",
+                "apply",
+                "--project-root",
+                str(self.root),
+                "--request",
+                str(self.write_request(request)),
+            ],
+        )
+        self.assert_open_consistent(request, self.response(opened, revision=0))
+        self.assert_private()
+        snapshot = self.run_isolated(
+            main, ["--json", "snapshot", "--project-root", str(self.root)]
+        )
+        self.response(snapshot, revision=0)
+        self.assertEqual(tree(install), before)
+        self.assertEqual(tree(self.cwd), cwd)
+
+    def test_controller_without_upper_layers_runs_end_to_end_from_two_install_roots(
+        self,
+    ) -> None:
+        installs = (
+            self.base / "install-a" / "autopilot",
+            self.base / "plugin cache" / "buvis" / "autopilot-0.10.0",
+        )
+        for index, install in enumerate(installs):
+            with self.subTest(install=install):
+                self.root = self.base / f"project-{index}"
+                self.root.mkdir()
+                sibling = self.base / f"project-{index}-extra"
+                sibling.mkdir()
+                self.exercise_install(install)
+                self.assertEqual(list(sibling.iterdir()), [])
+

+class ContractBundlePinnableTest(BundleAssertions):
+    def bundle(self) -> dict:

+    def test_contract_bundle_pinnable_regular_file_without_symlink_components(
+        self,
+    ) -> None:
+        path = ROOT

+            path = path / part
+            self.assertFalse(path.is_symlink(), path)
+        info = BUNDLE.lstat()
+        self.assertTrue(stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode))

+
+    def test_contract_bundle_pinnable_strict_object_with_exact_typed_keys(self) -> None:
+        bundle = self.bundle()
+        self.assertEqual(set(bundle), BUNDLE_KEYS)
+        self.assertIs(type(bundle["protocol_major"]), int)
+        self.assertEqual(bundle["protocol_major"], 1)
+        manifest = json.loads((PLUGIN / "plugin.json").read_bytes())
+        self.assertIs(type(bundle["package_version"]), str)
+        self.assertEqual(bundle["package_version"], manifest["version"])
+        self.assertNotEqual(bundle["package_version"], "")
+        for key, source in (("schema_digest", SCHEMA), ("fixture_digest", FIXTURES)):
+            self.assertIs(type(bundle[key]), str)
+            self.assertRegex(bundle[key], "^[0-9a-f]{64}$")
+            self.assertEqual(bundle[key], digest(PLUGIN / source))
+        self.assertNotEqual(bundle["schema_digest"], bundle["fixture_digest"])
+        for key, expected in (
+            ("operations", OPERATIONS),
+            ("capabilities", CAPABILITIES),
+        ):
+            self.assertIs(type(bundle[key]), list)
+            self.assertTrue(all(type(item) is str for item in bundle[key]))
+            self.assertEqual(len(bundle[key]), len(set(bundle[key])))
+            self.assertEqual(set(bundle[key]), expected)
+
+    def test_contract_bundle_pinnable_runtime_contract_matches_bundle(self) -> None:
+        completed = cli(["--json", "contract"], cwd=ROOT / "tests")
+        self.assertEqual(
+            completed.returncode, 0, completed.stderr.decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
+        )
+        self.assert_runtime_matches(strict_json(completed.stdout), self.bundle())
+
+    def test_contract_bundle_pinnable_readme_documents_raw_digest_and_argv(
+        self,
+    ) -> None:
+        raw = hashlib.sha256(BUNDLE.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
+        text = README.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
+        pin = f"{raw}  {BUNDLE_RELATIVE}"
+        self.assertIn(pin, text)
+        for line in text.splitlines():
+            if "controller-v1.json" in line:
+                for token in HEX.findall(line):
+                    self.assertEqual(token, raw, line)
+        # Every digest in the bundle pin's heading section is the raw digest.
+        for line in heading_section(text, pin):
+            for token in HEX.findall(line):
+                self.assertEqual(token, raw, line)
+        self.assertIn(INSTALLED_ARGV, text)
+        # The argv is stated affirmatively, not only inside a prohibition.
+        paragraphs = re.split(r"\n[ \t]*\n", text)
+        affirmative = [
+            block
+            for block in paragraphs
+            if INSTALLED_ARGV in block and not NEGATION.search(block)
+        ]
+        self.assertTrue(affirmative, "argv appears only beside a negation")
+

+    def test_valid_publication_guard_observes_every_boundary_before_proceeding(self) -> None:
+        current = self.seed_pair()
+        boundaries = []
+        observed = []
+        snapshots = []
+        other = self.directory / "state.json-extra"
+        other_backup = self.directory / "state.json.bak-extra"
+        other.write_bytes(b"near-match state evidence")
+        other_backup.write_bytes(b"near-match backup evidence")
+
+        def observe_boundary(boundary: DurabilityBoundary) -> None:
+            self.assertIn(tuple(boundaries), observed)
+            boundaries.append(boundary)
+            snapshots.append(self.pair())
+
+        def guard() -> None:
+            if tuple(boundaries) not in observed:
+                self.assertEqual(self.pair(), snapshots[-1])
+            observed.append(tuple(boundaries))
+
+        store = StateStore(self.path, boundary_hook=observe_boundary)
+        for revision in (1, 2):
+            with self.subTest(revision=revision):
+                boundaries.clear()
+                observed.clear()
+                snapshots[:] = [self.pair()]
+                result = store.transaction(lambda value: None, expected_revision=revision,
+                                           publication_guard=guard)
+                self.assertEqual(boundaries, list(DurabilityBoundary))
+                for count in range(len(boundaries) + 1):
+                    self.assertIn(tuple(boundaries[:count]), observed)
+                self.assertEqual(result, dict(current, revision=revision + 1))
+                self.assertEqual(self.store.read(), result)
+                self.assertEqual(json.loads(self.backup.read_bytes()), current)
+                self.assertEqual(other.read_bytes(), b"near-match state evidence")
+                self.assertEqual(other_backup.read_bytes(), b"near-match backup evidence")
+                current = result
+
+    def test_changed_publication_guard_rejects_every_boundary_and_preserves_exact_pair(self) -> None:
+        for revision in (1, 2):
+            for boundary in DurabilityBoundary:
+                directory = self.directory / f"{revision}-{boundary.value}"
+                directory.mkdir()
+                path = directory / "state.json"
+                backup = directory / "state.json.bak"
+                seed = StateStore(path)
+                initial = self.initial if revision == 1 else dict(frozen_state(owned=True), revision=0)
+                seed.initialize(initial)
+                for _ in range(revision):
+                    current = seed.transaction(lambda value: None)
+                before = (path.read_bytes(), backup.read_bytes())
+                calls = []
+                observed = []
+
+                def invalidate_evidence(item: DurabilityBoundary) -> None:
+                    calls.append(item)
+
+                def guard() -> None:
+                    observed.append(tuple(calls))
+                    if boundary in calls:
+                        raise RuntimeError(f"publication evidence changed: {boundary.value}")
+
+                with self.subTest(boundary=boundary, revision=revision):
+                    store = StateStore(path, boundary_hook=invalidate_evidence)
+                    with self.assertRaisesRegex(RuntimeError, f"changed: {boundary.value}"):
+                        store.transaction(lambda value: None, expected_revision=revision,
+                                          publication_guard=guard)
+                    expected = list(DurabilityBoundary)
+                    expected = expected[:expected.index(boundary) + 1]
+                    self.assertEqual(calls, expected)
+                    self.assertIn(tuple(expected), observed)
+                    self.assertEqual((path.read_bytes(), backup.read_bytes()), before)
+                    self.assertEqual(seed.read(), current)
+                    self.assertEqual(seed.read()["revision"], revision)
+
+    def test_publication_guard_rechecks_changed_evidence_before_state_replace(self) -> None:
+        self.seed_pair()
+        before = self.pair()
+        evidence_valid = True
+
+        def invalidate_evidence(boundary: DurabilityBoundary) -> None:
+            nonlocal evidence_valid
+            if boundary == DurabilityBoundary.STATE_TEMP_FSYNCED:
+                evidence_valid = False
+
+        def guard() -> None:
+            if not evidence_valid:
+                raise RuntimeError("publication evidence changed")
+
+        store = StateStore(self.path, boundary_hook=invalidate_evidence)
+        with self.assertRaisesRegex(RuntimeError, "publication evidence changed"):
+            store.transaction(lambda value: None, expected_revision=1,
+                              publication_guard=guard)
+        self.assertEqual(self.pair(), before)
+        self.assertEqual(self.store.read()["revision"], 1)
