diff --git a/tests/autopilot/test_helper_provenance_successor.py b/tests/autopilot/test_helper_provenance_successor.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..6dd2fc9
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/autopilot/test_helper_provenance_successor.py
@@ -0,0 +1,477 @@
+"""The helper map generator applies an explicit AP00018 successor receipt.
+
+README.md, CHANGELOG.md and the controller assets changed after AP00013, so a
+successor receipt bound to a later revision owns them while the AP00013
+receipt stays immutable. Shared synthetic builders live in
+test_helper_provenance.py.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import copy
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+from types import ModuleType
+
+import pytest
+from test_helper_provenance import (
+    REFRESHED,
+    asset_row,
+    by_key,
+    canon,
+    digest,
+    encode,
+    load_tool,
+    make_repo,
+    owner_row,
+    run_tool,
+    synthetic_map,
+    valid_receipts,
+)
+
+REPORTS = "docs/dev/project-management/autopilot/reports/"
+AP00013 = REPORTS + "00013-helper-delivery-receipts.json"
+SUCCESSOR = REPORTS + "00018-v2-controller-delivery-receipts.json"
+OVERRIDE = "reports/successor-override.json"
+CONTRACT = "plugins/autopilot/contracts/controller-v1.json"
+CONTROLLER = (
+    "plugins/autopilot/controller/main.py",
+    "plugins/autopilot/contracts/controller/state.json",
+)
+SHARED = REFRESHED[1:]
+# Prefix, suffix and substring near-misses of controller paths are not
+# controller assets.
+NEAR_MISSES = (
+    "plugins/autopilot/contracts/controller-v2.json",
+    "plugins/autopilot/controllers/main.py",
+    "plugins/autopilot/scripts/controller_shim.py",
+    "docs/controller-notes.md",
+)
+NOT_APPLICABLE_GATE = {
+    "status": "not-applicable",
+    "operation": "none",
+    "entry_point": None,
+}
+PLANNED = {
+    "status": "planned",
+    "artifact_id": None,
+    "artifact_sha256": None,
+    "tested_package_revision": None,
+}
+REVISIONS = ("c" * 40, "0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567")
+
+
+@pytest.fixture(scope="module")
+def tool() -> ModuleType:
+    return load_tool()
+
+
+def write_json(path: Path, data: object) -> bytes:
+    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    path.write_text(json.dumps(data, indent=2) + "\n")
+    return path.read_bytes()
+
+
+def build_repo(root: Path, tag: str) -> Path:
+    document = synthetic_map("4" * 40)
+    for path in CONTROLLER + NEAR_MISSES:
+        document["assets"].append({**asset_row(path), "evidence": dict(PLANNED)})
+    document["authored_file_owners"] += [owner_row(p, "00018") for p in CONTROLLER]
+    mapping = make_repo(root, "4" * 40, tag, document)
+    for path in (CONTRACT, *NEAR_MISSES):
+        write_json(root / path, {"tag": f"{tag} {path}"})
+    write_json(root / AP00013, {**valid_receipts(), "package_revision": "a" * 40})
+    return mapping
+
+
+def valid_successor(root: Path, revision: str = REVISIONS[0]) -> dict:
+    tests = (
+        "tests/autopilot/test_controller_bundle.py",
+        "tests/autopilot/test_helper_provenance_successor.py",
+    )
+    return {
+        "schema_version": 1,
+        "prd": "00018",
+        "supersedes": {
+            "artifact_id": AP00013,
+            "artifact_sha256": digest((root / AP00013).read_bytes()),
+        },
+        "package_revision": revision,
+        "paths": [*SHARED, CONTRACT, *CONTROLLER],
+        "tasks": [
+            {"tests": tests[0], "command": f"pytest -q {tests[0]}", "passed": 31},
+            {"tests": tests[1], "command": f"pytest -q {tests[1]}", "passed": 9},
+        ],
+        "real_host": {
+            "status": "unavailable",
+            "reason": "No real host is reachable from the sandbox.",
+        },
+    }
+
+
+def generate(
+    tool: ModuleType,
+    root: Path,
+    mapping: Path,
+    successor: dict | None = None,
+    successor_id: str = SUCCESSOR,
+) -> dict:
+    document = json.loads(mapping.read_bytes())
+    raw = (root / AP00013).read_bytes()
+    artifact = {"artifact_id": AP00013, "artifact_sha256": digest(raw)}
+    if successor is None:
+        return tool.apply(document, json.loads(raw), root, artifact)
+    written = write_json(root / successor_id, successor)
+    return tool.apply(
+        document,
+        json.loads(raw),
+        root,
+        artifact,
+        successor=successor,
+        successor_artifact={
+            "artifact_id": successor_id,
+            "artifact_sha256": digest(written),
+        },
+    )
+
+
+def assert_contract_rows(document: dict, path: str = CONTRACT) -> None:
+    rows = [r for r in document["assets"] if r["destination_path"] == path]
+    assert len(rows) == 1, rows
+    row = rows[0]
+    assert set(row) == set(asset_row(path))
+    assert row["source_asset_id"] is None
+    assert row["source_blob_sha256"] is None
+    # A new authored asset: adapted, no section plan, no entry point.
+    assert row["disposition"] == "adapted"
+    assert row["section_plan"] == []
+    assert row["entry_point_gate"] == NOT_APPLICABLE_GATE
+    cases = row["acceptance_cases"]
+    assert isinstance(cases, list) and cases, cases
+    assert any(case.get("status") == row["evidence"]["status"] for case in cases)
+    owners = [r for r in document["authored_file_owners"] if r["path"] == path]
+    assert len(owners) == 1, owners
+    assert set(owners[0]) == set(owner_row(path))
+    assert owners[0]["delivery_prd"] == "00018"
+    assert owners[0]["owner_repository"] == "buvis/agent-plugins"
+    assert owners[0]["source_asset_id"] is None
+    assert owners[0]["acceptance_cases"]
+
+
+def assert_other_rows_unchanged(baseline: dict, document: dict) -> None:
+    moved = {*SHARED, *CONTROLLER, CONTRACT}
+    kept = {"destination_blob_sha256", "evidence"}
+
+    def rest(doc: dict) -> list[dict]:
+        return [r for r in doc["assets"] if r["destination_path"] not in moved]
+
+    assert canon(rest(document)) == canon(rest(baseline))
+    old, new = (by_key(d["assets"], "destination_path") for d in (baseline, document))
+    for path in (*SHARED, *CONTROLLER):
+        trimmed = [
+            {k: v for k, v in rows[path].items() if k not in kept}
+            for rows in (old, new)
+        ]
+        assert canon(trimmed[0]) == canon(trimmed[1]), path
+    owners = [r for r in document["authored_file_owners"] if r["path"] != CONTRACT]
+    assert canon(owners) == canon(baseline["authored_file_owners"])
+    assert set(document) == set(baseline)
+    for key in set(baseline) - {"assets", "authored_file_owners"}:
+        assert canon(document[key]) == canon(baseline[key]), key
+    assert new[REFRESHED[0]]["evidence"]["artifact_id"] == AP00013
+    for path in NEAR_MISSES:
+        assert new[path]["evidence"] == PLANNED, path
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("revision", REVISIONS)
+def test_valid_successor_moves_shared_docs_and_controller_rows_to_it(
+    tool: ModuleType, tmp_path: Path, revision: str
+) -> None:
+    root = tmp_path / revision[:4]
+    mapping = build_repo(root, revision[:4])
+    baseline = generate(tool, root, mapping)
+    document = generate(tool, root, mapping, valid_successor(root, revision))
+    assets = by_key(document["assets"], "destination_path")
+    for path in SHARED:
+        sha = digest((root / path).read_bytes())
+        assert assets[path]["destination_blob_sha256"] == sha, path
+        assert assets[path]["evidence"] == {
+            "status": "passed",
+            "artifact_id": path,
+            "artifact_sha256": sha,
+            "tested_package_revision": revision,
+        }, path
+    cited = {
+        "status": "passed",
+        "artifact_id": SUCCESSOR,
+        "artifact_sha256": digest((root / SUCCESSOR).read_bytes()),
+        "tested_package_revision": revision,
+    }
+    for path in (*CONTROLLER, CONTRACT):
+        sha = digest((root / path).read_bytes())
+        assert assets[path]["destination_blob_sha256"] == sha, path
+        assert assets[path]["evidence"] == cited, path
+    assert_contract_rows(document)
+    assert_other_rows_unchanged(baseline, document)
+
+
+# `paths` is binding: the successor certifies exactly the paths it lists.
+NARROW = {
+    "contract-only": (CONTRACT,),
+    "changelog-and-one-controller": (SHARED[1], CONTROLLER[1]),
+}
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("listed", NARROW.values(), ids=NARROW.keys())
+def test_successor_certifies_only_the_paths_it_lists(
+    tool: ModuleType, tmp_path: Path, listed: tuple[str, ...]
+) -> None:
+    mapping = build_repo(tmp_path, "narrow")
+    baseline = generate(tool, tmp_path, mapping)
+    successor = {**valid_successor(tmp_path), "paths": list(listed)}
+    document = generate(tool, tmp_path, mapping, successor)
+    old, new = (by_key(d["assets"], "destination_path") for d in (baseline, document))
+    cited = {
+        "status": "passed",
+        "artifact_id": SUCCESSOR,
+        "artifact_sha256": digest((tmp_path / SUCCESSOR).read_bytes()),
+        "tested_package_revision": REVISIONS[0],
+    }
+    for path in (*SHARED, *CONTROLLER):
+        if path not in listed:
+            # Unlisted rows keep exactly what the generator gives them today.
+            assert canon(new[path]) == canon(old[path]), path
+            continue
+        sha = digest((tmp_path / path).read_bytes())
+        assert new[path]["destination_blob_sha256"] == sha, path
+        own = {**cited, "artifact_id": path, "artifact_sha256": sha}
+        assert new[path]["evidence"] == (cited if path in CONTROLLER else own), path
+    for path in set(SHARED) - set(listed):
+        assert new[path]["evidence"]["tested_package_revision"] == "a" * 40, path
+    for path in set(CONTROLLER) - set(listed):
+        assert new[path]["evidence"] == PLANNED, path
+    if CONTRACT in listed:
+        assert_contract_rows(document)
+        assert new[CONTRACT]["evidence"] == cited
+    else:
+        assert CONTRACT not in new
+        owners = {row["path"] for row in document["authored_file_owners"]}
+        assert CONTRACT not in owners
+    assert_other_rows_unchanged(baseline, document)
+
+
+def test_listed_controller_file_without_a_map_row_is_registered_once(
+    tool: ModuleType, tmp_path: Path
+) -> None:
+    mapping = build_repo(tmp_path, "unmapped")
+    listed = "plugins/autopilot/controller/autopilot_state/owner.py"
+    unlisted = "plugins/autopilot/controller/autopilot_state/other.py"
+    for path in (listed, unlisted):
+        write_json(tmp_path / path, {"tag": path})
+    successor = valid_successor(tmp_path)
+    successor["paths"].append(listed)
+    document = generate(tool, tmp_path, mapping, successor)
+    assert_contract_rows(document, listed)
+    row = by_key(document["assets"], "destination_path")[listed]
+    assert "AP00018" in row["adaptation_reason"]
+    assert row["destination_blob_sha256"] == digest((tmp_path / listed).read_bytes())
+    assert row["evidence"] == {
+        "status": "passed",
+        "artifact_id": SUCCESSOR,
+        "artifact_sha256": digest((tmp_path / SUCCESSOR).read_bytes()),
+        "tested_package_revision": REVISIONS[0],
+    }
+    owners = {r["path"] for r in document["authored_file_owners"]}
+    assets = {r["destination_path"] for r in document["assets"]}
+    assert unlisted not in assets and unlisted not in owners
+    mapping.write_bytes(encode(document))
+    again = generate(tool, tmp_path, mapping, successor)
+    assert_contract_rows(again, listed)
+    assert canon(again) == canon(document)
+
+
+INVALID = {
+    "wrong-prd": lambda d: d.update(prd="00013"),
+    "prd-near-miss": lambda d: d.update(prd="000180"),
+    "bool-schema": lambda d: d.update(schema_version=True),
+    "future-schema": lambda d: d.update(schema_version=2),
+    "upper-revision": lambda d: d.update(package_revision="C" * 40),
+    "short-revision": lambda d: d.update(package_revision="c" * 39),
+    "long-revision": lambda d: d.update(package_revision="c" * 41),
+    "revision-trailing-junk": lambda d: d.update(package_revision="c" * 40 + "-x"),
+    "revision-trailing-newline": lambda d: d.update(package_revision="c" * 40 + "\n"),
+    "empty-tasks": lambda d: d.update(tasks=[]),
+    "zero-passed": lambda d: d["tasks"][1].update(passed=0),
+    "negative-passed": lambda d: d["tasks"][1].update(passed=-1),
+    "string-passed": lambda d: d["tasks"][0].update(passed="31"),
+    "bool-passed": lambda d: d["tasks"][0].update(passed=True),
+    "blank-tests": lambda d: d["tasks"][1].update(tests="  "),
+    "blank-command": lambda d: d["tasks"][0].update(command=""),
+    "real-host-passed": lambda d: d["real_host"].update(status="passed"),
+    "real-host-skipped": lambda d: d["real_host"].update(status="skipped"),
+    "real-host-blank-status": lambda d: d["real_host"].update(status=""),
+    "blank-real-host-reason": lambda d: d["real_host"].update(reason=" "),
+    "supersedes-digest-mismatch": lambda d: d["supersedes"].update(
+        artifact_sha256=digest(b"other receipts")
+    ),
+    "supersedes-other-artifact": lambda d: d["supersedes"].update(
+        artifact_id=AP00013 + ".bak"
+    ),
+    "missing-supersedes": lambda d: d.pop("supersedes"),
+    "empty-paths": lambda d: d.update(paths=[]),
+    "duplicate-path": lambda d: d["paths"].append(SHARED[0]),
+    "non-string-path": lambda d: d["paths"].append(7),
+    "helper-path": lambda d: d["paths"].append(REFRESHED[0]),
+    "contract-near-miss": lambda d: d["paths"].append(NEAR_MISSES[0]),
+    "controller-near-miss": lambda d: d["paths"].append(NEAR_MISSES[1]),
+    "controller-substring-script": lambda d: d["paths"].append(NEAR_MISSES[2]),
+    "controller-substring-doc": lambda d: d["paths"].append(NEAR_MISSES[3]),
+    "dotdot-escape-from-controller": lambda d: d["paths"].append(
+        "plugins/autopilot/controller/../scripts/autopilot.py"
+    ),
+    "absolute-controller-path": lambda d: d["paths"].append("/" + CONTROLLER[0]),
+    "readme-suffix-near-miss": lambda d: d["paths"].append(SHARED[0] + ".bak"),
+}
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("change", INVALID.values(), ids=INVALID.keys())
+def test_successor_breaking_a_rule_is_refused_without_writing(
+    tool: ModuleType, tmp_path: Path, change
+) -> None:
+    mapping = build_repo(tmp_path, "bad")
+    good = valid_successor(tmp_path)
+    accepted = generate(tool, tmp_path, mapping, good, OVERRIDE)
+    readme = by_key(accepted["assets"], "destination_path")[SHARED[0]]
+    assert readme["evidence"]["tested_package_revision"] == REVISIONS[0]
+    bad = copy.deepcopy(good)
+    change(bad)
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
+        generate(tool, tmp_path, mapping, bad, OVERRIDE)
+    write_json(tmp_path / OVERRIDE, bad)
+    before = mapping.read_bytes()
+    receipts = (tmp_path / AP00013).read_bytes()
+    result = run_tool(
+        "--map",
+        mapping,
+        "--root",
+        tmp_path,
+        "--successor-receipts",
+        tmp_path / OVERRIDE,
+        cwd=tmp_path,
+    )
+    assert result.returncode == 1, result.stdout + result.stderr
+    assert "update_helper_map failed" in result.stderr
+    assert mapping.read_bytes() == before
+    assert (tmp_path / AP00013).read_bytes() == receipts
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "text",
+    ["[]\n", "{not json\n", "", "null\n"],
+    ids=["array", "malformed", "empty", "null"],
+)
+def test_default_successor_that_is_not_a_json_object_is_refused(
+    tmp_path: Path, text: str
+) -> None:
+    mapping = build_repo(tmp_path, "strict")
+    (tmp_path / SUCCESSOR).write_text(text)
+    before = mapping.read_bytes()
+    receipts = (tmp_path / AP00013).read_bytes()
+    result = run_tool("--map", mapping, "--root", tmp_path, cwd=tmp_path)
+    assert result.returncode == 1, result.stdout + result.stderr
+    assert "update_helper_map failed" in result.stderr
+    assert mapping.read_bytes() == before
+    assert (tmp_path / AP00013).read_bytes() == receipts
+
+
+def test_cli_applies_the_default_successor_idempotently(
+    tool: ModuleType, tmp_path: Path
+) -> None:
+    root, elsewhere = tmp_path / "repo", tmp_path / "cwd"
+    mapping = build_repo(root, "cli")
+    elsewhere.mkdir()
+    original = json.loads(mapping.read_bytes())
+    successor = write_json(root / SUCCESSOR, valid_successor(root, REVISIONS[1]))
+    receipts = (root / AP00013).read_bytes()
+    arguments = (
+        json.loads(receipts),
+        root,
+        {"artifact_id": AP00013, "artifact_sha256": digest(receipts)},
+    )
+    options = {
+        "successor": json.loads(successor),
+        "successor_artifact": {
+            "artifact_id": SUCCESSOR,
+            "artifact_sha256": digest(successor),
+        },
+    }
+    result = run_tool("--map", mapping, "--root", root, cwd=elsewhere)
+    assert result.returncode == 0, result.stderr
+    written = mapping.read_bytes()
+    assert written == encode(tool.apply(original, *arguments, **options))
+    again = run_tool("--map", mapping, "--root", root, cwd=elsewhere)
+    assert again.returncode == 0, again.stderr
+    assert mapping.read_bytes() == written
+    regenerated = tool.apply(json.loads(written), *arguments, **options)
+    assert canon(regenerated) == canon(json.loads(written))
+    assert_contract_rows(json.loads(written))
+    check = run_tool("--map", mapping, "--root", root, "--check", cwd=elsewhere)
+    assert check.returncode == 0, check.stderr
+    assert (root / AP00013).read_bytes() == receipts
+    assert (root / SUCCESSOR).read_bytes() == successor
+    # Changing only the successor receipt makes the written map stale.
+    write_json(root / SUCCESSOR, valid_successor(root, REVISIONS[0]))
+    stale = run_tool("--map", mapping, "--root", root, "--check", cwd=elsewhere)
+    assert stale.returncode == 1, stale.stdout + stale.stderr
+    assert mapping.read_bytes() == written
+
+
+def test_successor_flag_overrides_the_default_successor_path(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
+    mapping = build_repo(tmp_path, "flag")
+    write_json(tmp_path / SUCCESSOR, valid_successor(tmp_path, REVISIONS[0]))
+    override = write_json(tmp_path / OVERRIDE, valid_successor(tmp_path, REVISIONS[1]))
+    result = run_tool(
+        "--map",
+        mapping,
+        "--root",
+        tmp_path,
+        "--successor-receipts",
+        tmp_path / OVERRIDE,
+        cwd=tmp_path,
+    )
+    assert result.returncode == 0, result.stderr
+    assets = by_key(json.loads(mapping.read_bytes())["assets"], "destination_path")
+    for path in SHARED:
+        assert assets[path]["evidence"]["tested_package_revision"] == REVISIONS[1]
+    for path in (*CONTROLLER, CONTRACT):
+        assert assets[path]["evidence"] == {
+            "status": "passed",
+            "artifact_id": OVERRIDE,
+            "artifact_sha256": digest(override),
+            "tested_package_revision": REVISIONS[1],
+        }, path
+
+
+def test_without_a_successor_receipt_the_generator_behaves_as_today(
+    tmp_path: Path,
+) -> None:
+    mapping = build_repo(tmp_path, "none")
+    original = by_key(json.loads(mapping.read_bytes())["assets"], "destination_path")
+    receipts = (tmp_path / AP00013).read_bytes()
+    result = run_tool("--map", mapping, "--root", tmp_path, cwd=tmp_path)
+    assert result.returncode == 0, result.stderr
+    document = json.loads(mapping.read_bytes())
+    assets = by_key(document["assets"], "destination_path")
+    for path in CONTROLLER + NEAR_MISSES:
+        assert canon(assets[path]) == canon(original[path]), path
+    assert CONTRACT not in assets
+    assert CONTRACT not in {row["path"] for row in document["authored_file_owners"]}
+    for path in SHARED:
+        sha = digest((tmp_path / path).read_bytes())
+        assert assets[path]["evidence"] == {
+            "status": "passed",
+            "artifact_id": path,
+            "artifact_sha256": sha,
+            "tested_package_revision": "a" * 40,
+        }, path
+    assert (tmp_path / AP00013).read_bytes() == receipts

diff --git a/tools/autopilot/export-controller-contract.py b/tools/autopilot/export-controller-contract.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..12a416b
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tools/autopilot/export-controller-contract.py
@@ -0,0 +1,109 @@
+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Export the pinnable controller contract bundle of an autopilot plugin root.
+
+Writes <plugin-root>/contracts/controller-v1.json from plugin.json and the raw
+bytes of the controller schema and fixtures. --check writes nothing and exits 1
+when the bundle on disk is missing, not a regular file, or differs.
+Self-contained stdlib script; it never reads live workflow state.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import hashlib
+import json
+import os
+import stat
+import sys
+import tempfile
+from pathlib import Path
+
+DEFAULT_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent.parent / "plugins" / "autopilot"
+TARGET = Path("contracts") / "controller-v1.json"
+SCHEMA = Path("contracts") / "controller" / "workflow-v1.json"
+FIXTURES = Path("contracts") / "controller" / "fixtures-v1.json"
+# The export tests check these equal literal sets in the test and are a subset
+# of what `controller/main.py --json contract` reports.
+OPERATIONS = ["workflow.open", "owner.acquire", "owner.release", "owner.recover"]
+CAPABILITIES = ["workflow.core.v1"]
+LIMIT = 16777216
+
+
+def checked(root: Path, relative: Path, regular: bool = True) -> Path:
+    """root / relative with no symlink component; a regular file under LIMIT."""
+    path = root
+    for part in relative.parts:
+        path = path / part
+        info = path.lstat()
+        if stat.S_ISLNK(info.st_mode):
+            raise ValueError(f"{path} is a symlink")
+    if regular and not (stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode) and info.st_size < LIMIT):
+        raise ValueError(f"{path} is not a regular file under {LIMIT} bytes")
+    return path
+
+
+def build_bundle(root: Path) -> bytes:
+    manifest = json.loads(checked(root, Path("plugin.json")).read_bytes())
+    version = manifest.get("version") if isinstance(manifest, dict) else None
+    if not isinstance(version, str) or not version:
+        raise ValueError("plugin.json version must be a non-empty string")
+    bundle = {
+        "protocol_major": 1,
+        "package_version": version,
+        "schema_digest": hashlib.sha256(checked(root, SCHEMA).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
+        "fixture_digest": hashlib.sha256(
+            checked(root, FIXTURES).read_bytes()
+        ).hexdigest(),
+        "operations": OPERATIONS,
+        "capabilities": CAPABILITIES,
+    }
+    return (json.dumps(bundle, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n").encode("utf-8")
+
+
+def matches(target: Path, expected: bytes) -> bool:
+    try:
+        info = target.lstat()
+    except FileNotFoundError:
+        return False
+    return stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode) and target.read_bytes() == expected
+
+
+def write_atomic(target: Path, data: bytes, mode: int) -> None:
+    fd, temp = tempfile.mkstemp(dir=target.parent, prefix=f".{target.name}.")
+    try:
+        with os.fdopen(fd, "wb") as handle:
+            os.fchmod(handle.fileno(), mode)
+            handle.write(data)
+            handle.flush()
+            os.fsync(handle.fileno())
+        os.replace(temp, target)
+    except BaseException:
+        os.unlink(temp)
+        raise
+
+
+def main(argv: list[str]) -> int:
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__.splitlines()[0])
+    parser.add_argument("--plugin-root", type=Path, default=DEFAULT_ROOT)
+    parser.add_argument("--check", action="store_true")
+    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
+    root = args.plugin_root
+    try:
+        data = build_bundle(root)
+        checked(root, TARGET.parent, regular=False)
+        if args.check:
+            if matches(root / TARGET, data):
+                return 0
+            print(f"error: {root / TARGET} is stale or missing", file=sys.stderr)
+            return 1
+        # Same permission bits as the sibling contracts, not mkstemp's 0600.
+        mode = stat.S_IMODE((root / SCHEMA).stat().st_mode) & 0o666
+        write_atomic(root / TARGET, data, mode)
+    except (OSError, ValueError) as error:
+        print(f"error: {error}", file=sys.stderr)
+        return 1
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    sys.exit(main(sys.argv[1:]))

# Review Dimensions

Detailed checklist for reviewing completed work.

## Plan Compliance

- [ ] Implementation matches task description
- [ ] All acceptance criteria met
- [ ] No scope creep (extra features not requested)
- [ ] No missing pieces from original task

## PRD Coverage

- [ ] All "must have" requirements addressed
- [ ] Success metrics achievable with implementation
- [ ] No PRD sections left unimplemented
- [ ] Dependencies correctly handled

## Simplification

Hunt actively for simplification — do not just tick boxes. The diff under
review is fresh; this is the cheapest moment to cut complexity before it sets.
For every added or changed file, ask "what would make this simpler to read
without changing what it does?" and flag concrete opportunities.

- [ ] **Reduce complexity** — no needless indirection, dead branches, or
      abstractions built for a single caller; nesting <= 4 levels; functions
      under 50 lines
- [ ] **Eliminate redundancy** — no logic duplicated within the diff or against
      existing code; no helper that reimplements a stdlib or existing utility
- [ ] **Improve naming** — names state intent; no opaque abbreviations;
      action-named functions start with a verb
- [ ] **Follow project standards** — conventions from CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md and
      the surrounding code; no style drift
- [ ] **No dead code** — no commented-out blocks, unused imports, variables, or
      speculatively-added parameters
- [ ] **Appropriate error handling** — explicit, never silently swallowed

**How to flag a simplification:** give the file:line, the current shape, and
the simpler replacement. Flag concrete behavior-preserving simplifications at
🟡 Medium so the decision gate routes them into the rework loop. Do not inflate
them to 🟠 High; that floods the rework loop and can trip the scope alarm.

**Balance — do not over-simplify:** never propose a change that trades clarity
for brevity, drops error handling, collapses a deliberate boundary, or removes
a documented invariant. Simpler means easier to read and maintain, not shorter
at any cost. If a "simplification" would change behavior, it is out of scope —
do not flag it.

## Testing

- [ ] Unit tests for new logic
- [ ] Edge cases covered
- [ ] Error paths tested
- [ ] Integration tests if crossing boundaries
- [ ] Tests actually run and pass
- [ ] No tautological test — every new or changed test fails against the
      pre-change code (the context's fail-first replay block), and no assert
      is constant, self-comparing, or an either-or hedge (the shapes block)

## Security

- [ ] No hardcoded secrets
- [ ] Input validation at boundaries
- [ ] No SQL/command injection risks
- [ ] Auth/authz correctly applied
- [ ] Sensitive data not logged

## Documentation

- [ ] Public APIs documented
- [ ] Complex logic has comments
- [ ] README updated if needed
- [ ] Breaking changes noted

# Review-Work-Completion Rubric

This rubric defines binary pass/fail criteria for consensus review of completed work. Each rule is numbered and stable for tracking coverage. Reviewers must answer "R{n}: pass|fail" for every rule in their prompt.

## Rules

### Tests

R1: Tests cover every new behavior introduced by the diff.
R2: Tests bind to intent, not just observable behavior; no new or changed test is tautological (passes against the pre-change code, or cannot fail as written).
R3: No skipped or xfail tests mask failures.

### Integration

R4: Changed components integrate with existing callers.

### Security

R6: No hardcoded secrets in the codebase.
R7: All user input is validated and sanitized.
R8: No injection-unsafe queries or commands.

### Domain

R9: Implementation matches PRD feature behavior exactly.
R10: Error handling is explicit and not swallowed.
R11: No debug statements, TODOs, or placeholder markers remain.

### Code Quality

R12: Function sizes respect the 50-line limit.
R13: File sizes respect the 800-line limit.

## Agent Output Format (Single Source of Truth)

Each agent outputs issues in this exact format:

```
[{AGENT_NAME}] {emoji} {description} | File: {path or "N/A"} | Task: {id or "general"}

**Severity emojis:** 🔴 Critical, 🟠 High, 🟡 Medium, ⚪ Low

**Rules:**
- One issue per line
- Use "N/A" for file if issue is architectural/cross-cutting
- Use "general" for task if issue spans multiple tasks or is a PRD gap
- If zero issues found: `[{AGENT_NAME}] ✅ No issues found`

**Examples:**

[ALICE] 🔴 SQL injection in query builder | File: src/db/query.ts | Task: 3
[BOB] 🟠 Missing error handling strategy | File: N/A | Task: general
[CARL] 🟡 PRD section 2.3 not implemented | File: N/A | Task: 5

Weigh it when applying both lenses and the rubric verdicts rather than re-litigating known prior findings.

### 1. Doubt lens (correctness)
Surface residual findings a confident reviewer would wave past:
- spec gaps: PRD says X, code does Y (wrong field names, enum values,
  thresholds, artifact kind);
- missing or incomplete features the PRD requires;
- edge cases, error paths, and failure modes left unhandled;
- tests that cannot fail: they assert the implementation rather than the intent,
  or still pass against the pre-change code (the caller's mechanical test checks
  list every one it found; each is behavior left unpinned).

### 2. De-slop lens (quality)
Flag slop introduced by the changes (do not propose broad refactors):
- over-abstraction / single-caller indirection with no current testability or
  architectural need;
- dead code, code kept in comments, unreachable branches;
- defensive guards for states that cannot occur;
- restating docstrings, "robust" error messages with no context, premature
  configuration, framework-verification tests;
- speculative generality (parameters, hooks, or layers nothing uses yet).
Bias: aggressive on newly-created files (slop concentrates there), conservative
on lightly-touched files (do not destabilize existing behavior).

## Categorize every residual finding

Place EACH finding in exactly one bucket:
- **FIX** — genuinely fixable now: bounded scope, in-scope, actionable.
- **VERIFY** — needs a specific named check to resolve (state the exact check,
  not "look into X").
- **KNOWN** — a real limitation that is out of scope; include a one-line written
  justification.

Output the buckets as three sections, one finding per line:

```
FIX:
- <finding> — <file:line> — <the concrete fix>
VERIFY:
- <finding> — <the exact check to run>
KNOWN:
- <finding> — <why it is out of scope>
```

If a bucket is empty, write the header and `- (none)`.

## Rubric verdicts (REQUIRED — emit verbatim, one per line)

Apply the doubt-review rubric. A rule you cannot evaluate is `fail`; never omit
a line.
- D1: every residual finding is in exactly one of FIX/VERIFY/KNOWN.
- D2: all FIX items are genuinely fixable now (bounded, in-scope, actionable).
- D3: all VERIFY items name the exact check needed (not vague).
- D4: all KNOWN items carry a written out-of-scope justification.
- D5: input finding count equals FIX + VERIFY + KNOWN counts.

Emit exactly:

```
D1: pass|fail
D2: pass|fail
D3: pass|fail
D4: pass|fail
D5: pass|fail
```

Do not modify any files. This is a review only — produce findings and the
rubric verdict lines. No commits.

Cite files repo-relative as path:line (for example skills/work/SKILL.md:166), never absolute and never with a "(lines a-b)" suffix.
